title: Track Campaign Core
description: A four-image identity-locked motorsport promo system built around one original race car and livery language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes one original endurance-style race car, its livery rhythm, and its team atmosphere. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the exact car identity while changing track condition, speed mood, and promo emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
